dct_title_s: Viet Nam - Tropical depression on Aug 28 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001202\_10](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001202) Tropical depression during the period Aug 28 2025-Aug 30 2025 in Viet Nam, China, Laos, Thailand. The center of the storm was located near latitude 18.0 longitude 104.4. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
